---
title: "Blog"

# Year headings are not linkable sections, so suppress Quarto's hover anchor links.
# This also keeps the emitted class attribute exactly "archive-year".
anchor-sections: false

listing:
  id: archive
  contents: posts/**/*.qmd
  template: ejs/archive.ejs
  sort: "date desc"
  # ejs/archive.ejs pulls the year heading out of this already-formatted string with
  # a four-digit match, so the format must contain a four-digit year. Listing items do
  # not inherit date-format from posts/_metadata.yml, so it has to be declared here.
  date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
  page-size: 0
  feed: true
---

::: {#archive}
:::
